question: Which state has topped the Fiscal Health Index (FHI) 2025 ranking launched by NITI Aayog?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **NITI Aayog launched the Fiscal Health Index (FHI) 2025, assessing the fiscal health of 18 major states in India.**
 
• **Odisha topped the FHI 2025 rankings with a composite score of 67.8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Odisha ranked first, followed by Chhattisgarh (55.2) and Goa (53.6).**
 
• The rankings are based on five sub-indices: Quality of Expenditure, Revenue Mobilisation, Fiscal Prudence, Debt Index, and Debt Sustainability.
 
• The FHI promotes a data-driven approach to assess and improve fiscal governance in states.
 
• It identifies regional disparities and highlights areas requiring targeted policy reforms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Fiscal Health Index (FHI)**__

 __
 
• An annual publication by NITI Aayog aimed at improving fiscal governance and economic resilience.
 
• Focuses on state-level fiscal performance using data-driven insights.
 
 
 
• **Odisha’s Performance**__
 __
 
• Excelled in revenue mobilisation, expenditure management, and debt sustainability.
 
• Set an example for other states in fiscal discipline and strategic planning.
 
 
 
• **Cooperative Federalism**__
 
 
• The FHI emphasizes collaboration between the Centre and states to address fiscal challenges and promote balanced economic growth.
